title: Demo — The Candlelit Cut
venue: The Velvet Cypress Supper Club • Fictional Baton Rouge, Louisiana
description: An upscale Baton Rouge supper club dinner turns deadly when a photographer is found in the candle alcove. This easy case guides players through physical evidence, forensics, witness statements, and a clear alibi contradiction.

answerKey.method: Shoved Elise in the candle alcove, then staged the scene as a fall using the curtain and wax trail.
answerKey.motive: To hide that she was selling private guest-list information from the supper club.
answerKey.keyEvidence: Wax trail, gold cufflink, Elise’s photo burst, staff tracker, and service-door chime.
answerKey.explanation: Nora had access to the host terminal and guest list, was placed near the alcove during the critical window, and lied about staying at the host stand. The waxed cufflink and photo burst connect her to the staged fall.

publicClues.title: Case Opened
publicClues.text: The Velvet Cypress dining room is sealed after photographer Elise Renaud is found in the candle service alcove. The room smells of warm wax, truffle butter, and rain-soaked coats from the porte-cochère.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: A server whispers that the candle alcove was checked twice tonight. The maître d’ insists the second check never happened, but the reservation stand still has fresh wax on one corner.

publicClues.title: Detective Decision 1 Available
publicClues.text: You have enough from the first scene search to decide which physical detail made Elise’s fall look staged.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: Nora Vale straightens the brass table numbers while asking if anyone has seen her gold cufflink. The question lands badly because no one had mentioned a cufflink yet.

publicClues.title: Detective Decision 2 Available
publicClues.text: The witness timeline now conflicts with the candle-service records.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: Rain taps against the covered entry. A runner says the wax trail at the alcove door stayed glossy longer than the candles on the tables, as if it was moved after service began.

publicClues.title: Detective Decision 3 Available
publicClues.text: Forensics can now help you decide whose story does not fit the physical evidence.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: A private guest demands their phone back from the evidence table. The screen shows Elise’s last photo still open: Nora standing too close to the alcove curtain.

publicClues.title: Detective Decision 4 Available
publicClues.text: The motive trail has moved from the scene to the reservation list.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: The DJ lowers the room music. For the first time, everyone hears the service-door chime repeat in the security log playback.

publicClues.title: Final Accusation Open
publicClues.text: All five Detective Decisions are complete. Close the case by naming the killer, method, motive, and key proof.

phone.title: Elise’s Last Photo Queue
phone.text: Elise’s phone shows a burst of photos taken at 8:47 PM near the candle alcove. One blurred frame catches Nora’s white maître d’ sleeve reflected in the black lacquer wall.

phone.title: Missed Call From Reservation Stand
phone.text: At 8:50 PM, Elise ignored a call from the reservation stand even though she had just photographed that area.

messages.title: Text About the Guest List
messages.text: Elise texted her assistant: “Nora is selling private guest names. I have the photo.”

messages.title: Assistant Reply
messages.text: The assistant replied, “Do not confront her alone. Send me the picture first.” Elise never did.

maps.title: Staff Tracker Ping
maps.text: Nora’s staff tracker shows her near the candle alcove at 8:49 PM, not at the host stand as she claimed.

maps.title: Service Door Chime Map
maps.text: The side service door chime logs movement from the alcove corridor toward the reservation stand at 8:51 PM.

bank.title: Guest List Payment
bank.text: A payment labeled “private seating lead” hit Nora’s personal account two days before the dinner.

bank.title: Refund Pressure
bank.text: A VIP threatened to pull future bookings if the guest-list leak became public.

photos.title: Wax Trail Photo
photos.text: The first scene photo shows a narrow wax trail ending at the alcove door. It bends upward on the door trim, which would not happen if Elise simply tripped forward.

photos.title: Gold Cufflink Close-Up
photos.text: A gold cufflink sits under the alcove curtain. Wax fills its hinge, as if it was pressed against a still-warm service candle.

social.title: Tagged Dinner Reel
social.text: A guest reel shows Nora wearing matching gold cufflinks during the first toast.

social.title: Deleted Caption
social.text: Elise’s deleted caption read: “Some secrets are seated before the guests arrive.”

contacts.title: Witness Statement: Briant the Server
contacts.text: Briant says Nora personally handled the candle alcove after the first course and told servers not to touch the curtain.

contacts.title: Witness Statement: Nora Vale
contacts.text: Nora says she stayed at the host stand after 8:45 PM and never entered the alcove once guests sat down.

contacts.title: Witness Statement: Margo Chen
contacts.text: Margo says she heard Elise say, “I got the photo,” just before the service-door chime sounded.

contacts.title: Witness Statement: Theo Lark
contacts.text: Theo says Nora asked about a missing cufflink before anyone had searched the alcove.

notes.title: Detective Note: First Search
notes.text: The body location is obvious, but the wax pattern is the first clue that the scene was arranged after contact.

notes.title: Detective Note: Alibi Target
notes.text: Nora’s alibi depends on the host stand, so any movement record between 8:45 and 8:51 matters.

files.title: Reservation Stand Log
files.text: The host terminal was unlocked under Nora’s manager code at 8:50 PM.

files.title: Door Chime Export
files.text: The service-door chime recorded one exit from the alcove corridor at 8:51 PM.

browser.title: Search History
browser.text: Nora’s tablet searched “how to delete shared photo burst iPhone” at 8:52 PM.

browser.title: VIP Directory Draft
browser.text: A browser tab shows a drafted private guest directory with prices beside several names.

openingNarration: Welcome to The Candlelit Cut. Search the candle alcove first, then let the evidence, forensics, and witness statements build the timeline.
revealScript: The case closes on Nora Vale. She tried to turn a confrontation into an accident, but the room remembered what she moved: the wax, the cufflink, the door chime, and Elise’s final photo.

seriesArc: Three separate mysteries inside a fictional upscale Baton Rouge supper club inspired by candlelit fine dining, dress-code drama, private tables, and late-night lounge energy.
lobbyBackstory: You are checked in at The Velvet Cypress Supper Club, a fictional candlelit Baton Rouge dining room where privacy is part of the price. Tonight, photographer Elise Renaud is found in a service alcove before dessert. Start with the scene, then let evidence and testimony fill the truth.
rsvpExcerpt: A candlelit private dinner turns deadly when a photographer is found behind the velvet curtain. Search the scene, test the alibi, and uncover what one polished host was desperate to hide.
